correctness.rationale: The four source Gauss codes were independently transcribed and checked. Each has odd crossings 1,2,4,5 with signs all negative, hence J=-4. Reidemeister invariance of J and the at-most-two change in J under one crossing change give u>=2. A standalone checker verifies that changing crossings 1 and 4 in each code permits the stated RI/RII cancellations to the empty code, giving u<=2. The claim is finite and no enumeration is used to infer an infinite theorem.
